plugins.name: zcode-auto-compact
plugins.description: Makes ZCode's built-in auto-compact trigger at a configurable percentage of the model's context window (default 70%). A reversible patch to one engine function plus a threshold slider injected into the context-usage popup (one-line app.asar entry, reversible); nothing is injected into the model context. Settings dialog (/compact-settings), engine/asar restore and self-update via the official zcode CLI.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 自动上下文压缩：让 ZCode 自带的自动压缩按设定的百分比触发（默认为模型上下文窗口的 70%）。给引擎的一个函数打可还原补丁，并在上下文容量弹窗里注入阈值滑块（app.asar 入口一行、可还原）；不往模型上下文注入文字。带设置弹窗（/compact-settings）、引擎/asar 还原与自动更新。
